feat(core): add PDF export support and switch image format to PNG

refactor: simplify imports in RHFVisualizationSelector and SaveButton components
Consolidated unnecessary imports and type declarations to improve code readability and maintainability. Adjusted imports in React and removed unused callbacks to streamline the codebase.

chore(package.json): version update
Updated app version to 1.0.0-beta.06

fix(access-config): Fixes
- Fixed issues with focusing error by useForm causes an error to be thrown - Changed the validation of PAT to accomodate new pattern starting with v41 of DHIS2

chore: update dependencies and remove unused VCS configuration
Updated `turbo` to v2.5.3 and `pnpm` to v10.10.0 for improved performance and compatibility. Removed unnecessary VCS configuration from `.idea/vcs.xml`. Addressed deprecated packages in `pnpm-lock.yaml` to ensure package relevancy and avoid potential issues.

chore(dependencies): update package lockfile
Updated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to reflect dependency version upgrades. The changes were applied to ensure compatibility, security, and to leverage the latest features/bug fixes of the updated libraries such as `@tanstack/react-query`, `next`, `express`, `axios`, `@apollo/server`, and others.

chore(deps): update `puppeteer-core`, `puppeteer`, and related dependencies to latest versions
Upgraded `puppeteer-core` to `24.8.2`, alongside updates to dependent packages like `puppeteer`, `puppeteer-extra`, and plugins to ensure compatibility with the latest browser versions and features. Includes upgrades for additional dependencies like `@types/node` and various `bare-*` modules to improve performance and functionality.

fix(access-config): resolved errors with `useForm` focus and PAT validation
- Fixed issues where focusing errors in `useForm` caused an error to be thrown. - Updated validation logic for PAT to support DHIS2 v41+ patterns.

chore: add Vite environment type references
Added `vite-env.d.ts` to provide TypeScript definitions for Vite client and import meta, ensuring better type safety and developer experience.

feat(dashboards): add dashboards configuration module
Introduced a new module for managing dashboards in push analytics configurations. This includes a `DashboardsConfigPage` component, related logic for fetching and saving dashboard settings, and a `DashboardSelector` component for selecting dashboards via a UI interface. Included hooks for data handling, updated navigation, and added necessary i18n translations. Tailwind integration was also added for streamlined styling.

feat(dashboards): add onSave handler to reset form after saving
Introduced an `onSave` handler in Dashboards to reset the form with updated data after saving. Updated the save button to use the new handler to ensure the form state reflects the latest dashboard data upon saving.

feat(push-analytics): add dashboard support and enhance flexibility
- Introduced a new `RHFDashboardSelector` component to enable dashboard selection in Push Analytics configurations. - Implemented a `TypeSelector` component to toggle between visualizations and dashboards. - Updated `PushAnalyticsModalConfig` to support dashboards alongside visualizations while enforcing at least one selection. - Added a new `SaveButton` component for saving dashboard configurations efficiently. - Updated environment variable references from `process.env` to `import.meta.env` for compatibility with Vite builds. - Replaced `CustomDataTable` with `SimpleDataTable` for better performance and simplicity. - Enhanced UI components (`StatusIndicator`, `ActionButton`) by switching to `@dhis2/ui` styled buttons for improved UI consistency.
These changes aim to improve the flexibility and user experience of Push Analytics while transitioning to a more modern development environment.

style: normalize code formatting and clean up imports across components
This commit standardizes code formatting with consistent spacing and indentation in multiple files to improve readability. Additionally, it updates import paths to simplify and align with current project structure. Minor refactors ensure better code clarity and maintainability.

feat(dbSchemas): add dashboards field to push schema
Added a new "dashboards" field of type Array to the push schema to support storing dashboard-related data. This enhances the schema's capability to manage additional use cases.

feat: add dashboard image generation support alongside visualizations
Extend the analytics service to support dashboard image generation using `getDashboards` in addition to the existing `getVisualizations`. This improves versatility by enabling message creation for both dashboards and visualizations. Refactored related logic in the messaging and visualization utilities for cleaner configuration handling.

feat(visualizer): introduce DashboardVisualizer and related components for modular visualization
- Added `DashboardVisualizer` to enable dashboard-based visualization with a grid layout using `react-grid-layout`. - Introduced `DashboardItemVisualizer` and `DashboardLayoutItemContainer` for handling individual visualization items in the dashboard. - Added `VisualizationError` to handle error boundaries in visualizations. - Updated `LegacyVisualizer` to support optional title rendering and reused it in `StandaloneVisualizer`. - Changed styles in `Visualization` for improved layout handling. - Bumped dependencies such as `@dhis2/analytics` to `^27.0.1` for compatibility and stability.
These changes aim to modularize visualizer components, improve reusability, and add enhanced dashboard visualization capabilities.
fix(visualizer): Fixes on visualizer having inconsistent data due to use query caching

feat(visualizer): improve UI consistency and add chart footer component
Refined padding, headers, and styles for `LegacyVisualizer` and `DashboardVisualizer` to enhance UI consistency. Added a `ChartFooter` component to `DashboardVisualizer` to standardize footer content, and updated `DashboardLayoutItemContainer` to include border styling using DHIS2 UI colors. Adjusted `Footer` components with better alignment, spacing, and content clarification for branding.

feat(visualizer): add `dashboard` prop for enhanced dashboard visualization support
Introduced a `dashboard` prop to components (`Visualization`, `LegacyVisualizer`, `DashboardItemVisualizer`) to enable differentiation of rendering behavior for dashboards. Updated `useVisualizationData` hook to handle compact legend set mapping and ensure accurate API queries for legend data. Enhancements improve flexibility and maintainability of visualizations across standalone and dashboard contexts.

feat(visualizer): improve dashboard item loading and support unsupported visualizations
- Added `loaded-dashboard-item` class to track loaded visualizations and ensure all items are fully loaded before proceeding. - Introduced `NotSupportedVisualization` component to handle unsupported visualization types with a cleaner design. - Refactored dashboard loading logic to handle dynamic heights and ensure proper rendering. - Updated `StandaloneVisualizer` to push the current item to `window.items` for tracking. - Enhanced logging for better traceability during visualization loading.
These changes improve reliability, rendering accuracy, and the user experience when dealing with dashboards and visualizations.

feat(utils): improve dashboard rendering by dynamically setting viewport dimensions
Added logic to dynamically set viewport height and width based on the `#dashboard-page` dimensions, ensuring accurate rendering. Introduced a delay to allow charts to fully load before measuring dimensions.

fix(utils): ensure safe handling of bounding box dimensions in `setViewport`
Refactored the visualization utility to use `boundingBox.height` and `boundingBox.width` with null coalescing to prevent potential `undefined` values. This improves stability when setting the viewport dimensions.

feat(utils): improve dashboard loading and error handling
Enhanced the dashboard loading process by adding detailed logging for progress and status updates. Adjusted the viewport setting logic to ensure accurate page dimensions. Introduced error handling for cases where the dashboard page is unavailable. This improves transparency and reliability during visualization rendering.

refactor(utils): improve dashboard visualization loading logic
- Introduced delay helper for better control over async operations. - Enhanced loading checks with `.dashboard-item` and `.loaded-dashboard-item`. - Adjusted viewport settings for consistent 1920x1080 resolution capture. - Improved error handling and loading feedback for dashboards. - Updated dependencies: upgraded `react-hook-form`, `@hookform/resolvers`, and `zod` for enhanced compatibility and functionality. - Removed unused `username` in password reset logic for cleaner code.
These changes improve visualization performance, ensure compatibility with upgraded dependencies, and enhance code maintainability.

feat(core): add PDF export support and switch image format to PNG
- Introduced `getPDF` function to enable exporting visualizations as PDFs with specified dimensions and settings. - Changed screenshot export format from JPEG to PNG for better quality. - Updated default viewport width from 1920 to 1980 to enhance dashboard rendering. - Replaced image export with PDF export in dashboard capture functionality.
